card.name: Words of relation and derivation
card.fires_on: Words that express a counterpart or derivation, such as correlate, corollary, derivative and 'derivative of', and the parts of related words like Cor-relation and co-terminous.

modes.label: Correlate and related terms
modes.description: The word correlate, or part of correlation or coterminous, in abstract or technical prose.
modes.example: Let us ask what the three<< correlates>> are to which a thought-sign refers.

modes.label: Derivative of / from
modes.description: The linking word after 'derivative' or 'taken', saying what something comes from.
modes.example: SOHONOS is a derivative<< of>> vitamin A.
